title: Protect The Thief
description: Protect The Thief is an engaging and strategic puzzle game where you play the role of a sneaky thief trying to collect treasures without getting caught. Navigate through various challenging levels, dodge obstacles, and outsmart guards to secure the loot. With its colorful graphics and addictive gameplay, Protect The Thief will keep you entertained for hours.
